verdict_choice.why: All three options are factually inaccurate as worded: (I) is refuted by measured RLSA 19.9620 @ 0.2010 s; (II) is refuted by the 0.121-0.132 gap (15x the 0.008 flip resolution); (III)'s stated reason is false (a same-budget measurement DOES exist). III is nevertheless the only defensible position for the paper: we cannot claim comparability, hence cannot claim SOTA at 0.2 s. Dependence: it holds only because the same-budget evidence that exists puts us behind; it would flip to (I) only if RLSA's 0.201 s point were shown non-comparable in protocol.
verdict_choice.paper_wording_recommended: NEITHER budget tier constitutes SOTA: 1 s is 0.015 behind (20.0690 vs 20.084), 0.2 s is 0.121 behind (19.8410 vs 19.9620 @ 0.2010 s). The only statement that holds at 0.2 s is +0.32 versus the authors' released RLNN (paired +0.321 [+0.288,+0.355], 332 wins / 645 equal / 23 losses) - and beating our own predecessor is not SOTA. Do not describe the 1 s tier as a parity claim either.

limitations: The 0.2 s value 19.8410 INCLUDES dataset-level capture amortisation: capture_s=0.817 is paid once for 1000 graphs (0.8 ms/graph, padded_ref0.json padded.capture_s). With per-graph re-capture at the same 0.2 s the value is only 19.3970 (49.8 steps, 3 seeds 1017/1019/1021, outputs/v8_macro/author_short/capture_budget/capture_budget_ref0.csv) - 0.12 BELOW RLNN's 19.520. This belongs in the limitations section, not a footnote: reviewers will ask whether the 0.2 s includes capture.

19.8410 is single-seed with no CI (padded_ref0.json seeds=[1017], repeats=1); PAVE accounting does not close (solve_time_s 0.188 vs decode_time_s 0.103 are not additive). Both are written as 'not measured', never estimated. t7 will supply the 3-seed run.
missing_for_paper: 3 seeds for the 19.8410 protocol (padded_short has seed 1017 only, repeats=1) -> no CI, no seed variance
hard time-limited RLSA at 0.2 s: outputs/v1/rlsa/run.json has config.time_budget_s=null -> RLSA's 0.201 s is a fixed num_t budget, not a deadline; an equal-deadline RLSA run does not exist on disk
RLSA seed replication: single search_seed 1017, no repeats anywhere
PAVE inclusion: 19.8410 is final_size (PAVE +0.0070); search_size is 19.8340. The paper must state which one is compared and that decode/PAVE sits inside solve_time_s=0.188 s
capture amortisation must be stated: 19.8410 relies on one 0.817 s capture for the whole 1000-graph set; per-graph capture gives 19.3970 at the same 0.2 s
KaMIS absence at 0.2 s needs an explicit sentence (floor 1.87 s, 0/1000 graphs), otherwise reviewers will ask
